title: My first game ever, built with Claude as my coding partner: Néon Orbite, a neon space arcade on Android
author: Ok_Leadership_429
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I'm not a professional game dev, and Néon Orbite is the very first game I've ever made and published. I built it almost entirely by working with Claude, step by step, version after version (I'm at v85 now).

The stack is simple: a pure JavaScript canvas engine, no framework, packaged for Android with Capacitor, with AdMob rewarded ads and offline mode through a service worker.

What went well: Claude was great for gameplay ideas and quick iterations (soft planet gravity, dash, zoom, alien visitors, a surprise mothership, handcrafted levels and an endless mode to chase high scores).  
What was hard: mobile performance. Stutters on restart that never showed up on PC took many rounds of fixes, and keeping version numbers consistent across files was a real lesson.

Since it's my first game, please go easy on me, but any constructive feedback is welcome, on the game itself or on the AI workflow.

Free on Google Play:  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fr.digitalsky.neonorbite](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fr.digitalsky.neonorbite)

Thanks for watching!
